## Azure learning portfolio — operations
One page: the free SQL limit (the unit that bites), Function run history and failures, and what this workspace ingests. Alert `alert-sql-free-limit` emails `ag-azportfolio-ops` when `free_amount_consumed` passes the threshold. Build #12.

content.title: Free SQL vCore-seconds: consumed (max) and remaining (min), last 30 days — 100,000/month is the line

content.query: AppRequests | extend app = tostring(split(AppRoleName, '/')[0]) | summarize runs=count(), failed=countif(Success == false), avg_ms=round(avg(DurationMs), 0), max_ms=max(DurationMs) by app, day=bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | order by day asc, app asc
content.title: Function runs per day (K03)

content.query: union isfuzzy=true (AppRequests | where Success == false | extend app = tostring(split(AppRoleName, '/')[0]), what = 'failed request', detail = strcat(Name, ' -> ', ResultCode)), (AppExceptions | extend app = tostring(split(AppRoleName, '/')[0]), what = 'exception', detail = strcat(ExceptionType, ': ', substring(OuterMessage, 0, 160))) | project TimeGenerated, app, what, detail | order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Failures and exceptions (K04)

content.query: Usage | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where IsBillable == true | summarize mb=round(sum(Quantity), 2) by DataType | order by mb desc
content.title: Ingestion by table, MB, last 30 days (K06) — free line is 5,120 MB
